tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search literal words in public normalized journal records. Use before reading a returned ID. No private results, generated answers or external fetches. Cursor expires after one hour; maximum 100 records.

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Retrieve a stable ID returned by search, including exact INR/paise values, precision, source and freshness. Read-only; private evidence and arbitrary paths are unavailable.
